_comment: Copy to permissions.json to change what Thursday may do to this machine.
The built-in protected paths (.env, .ssh, credentials, Thursday's own
settings and database) are always added to deny_paths - a typo here
cannot expose them. Everything else is yours to set.
Run `thursday permissions` to see what is in force.
_deny_paths: Extra paths never read or written. Globs, matched on the resolved path.
_tools: allow (just do it), confirm (ask first), deny (never).
_denied_tools: Switched off entirely, whatever else says.
_denied_commands: Extra shell patterns to refuse, on top of the built-ins.
